verdict.rationale: Smooth's core is a first-party AI agent that accepts natural-language tasks, such as finding the cheapest flight, and executes them autonomously. Users can watch it live, cancel it, or take over, and one hands-on user reports it handled a complex prompt well. Delegation is documented only through code (SDK/REST API) or via an external agent such as Claude Code driving the CLI, not through an assistant built into a product interface. missing for 10: an in-product assistant interface for delegating tasks without writing code, independent evidence beyond a single anecdotal user report.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: task = smooth_client.run("Go to google flights and find the cheapest flight from London to Paris today")
You can run AI-powered tasks, create interactive browser sessions, and extend agent capabilities with custom tools.
Every session comes with a live view URL where you can watch your agent browse in real-time. You can also take over and interact with the browser yourself.
I just wrote a complex prompt and it did a good job.
